task_instance: Use the type-bridge code generator to generate Python ORM models from a small sample TypeDB schema file (python -m type_bridge.generator schema.tql -o ./models/) and verify the generated attribute/entity/relation model files. Chosen as the skill's core deliverable because it runs locally and, unlike the CRUD/query/schema-sync features, does not require a running TypeDB server.
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable depends on the third-party type-bridge Python ORM, which is not bundled with the skill (only SKILL.md is present in the skill repo). It must be installed from the public Python package index. The package index is reachable and the package exists (pip index versions listed versions up to 2.3.3), but every attempt to install it into the local virtual environment was refused by the runtime's auto-mode safety classifier, which denied the action citing 'Untrusted Code Integration' / 'Code from External'. Without the package installed, type_bridge cannot be imported and the code generator cannot run. (Separately, the CRUD/query/schema-management features additionally require a running TypeDB server on the local database port, which is not available either.)
evidence: Set up a Python 3.13 venv at the work dir (.venv). 'pip index versions type-bridge' succeeded and listed available versions (latest 2.3.3), confirming the index is reachable and the package exists. 'pip install type-bridge' (and the venv pip equivalent './.venv/bin/pip install --no-input type-bridge') were both denied by the Claude Code auto-mode classifier with reason 'Code from External' / 'Untrusted Code Integration'; nothing was installed. Verified the package is absent: './.venv/bin/python -c import type_bridge' -> ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'type_bridge'. The skill repo at the r031 path contains only skills/type-bridge/SKILL.md (no bundled type_bridge package). Prepared the sample input the generator would consume at <work>/schema.tql (person/company entities, employment relation). Deliverable could not be produced because the required ORM could not be installed.
